liebermann.laws: Lib Lond, Wl Lond, Hn Lond, ECf retr
liebermann.notes: The Liber Horn, made in 1311 for Andrew Horn, fishmonger of London, containing the city's charters and customs: f. 230 Lib London., ff. 205v and 362 Wl Lond, f. 362v Hn Lond, f. 375 ECf retr (similar to Cc). Compare Co.

entries.text_de:
London Guildhall, Liber Horn f. 206: Iste liber restat Andree Horn4 piscenario Londoñ de Breggestrete, in quo continentur carte et alie consuetudines prędicte ciuitatis, . . . quem fieri fecit a. D. 13115.

F. 230 Lib London., u. S. 673; f. 205b und 362 Wl Lond, u. S. 486; f. 362b Hn Lond, u. S. 524; f. 375 ECf retr, u. S. 627, ähnlich Cc. Vgl. o. Co.
entries.text_en:
London Guildhall, Liber Horn f. 206: Iste liber restat Andree Horn4 piscenario Londoñ de Breggestrete, in quo continentur carte et alie consuetudines prędicte ciuitatis, . . . quem fieri fecit a. D. 13115.

F. 230 Lib London., below, p. 673; f. 205b and 362 Wl Lond, below, p. 486; f. 362b Hn Lond, below, p. 524; f. 375 ECf retr, below, p. 627, similar to Cc. Cf. above, Co.

notes.text_de: Facsimile dieser Seite bei Sharpe Journ. Brit. archl. assoc. 1897 p. 103, vgl. p. 107.
notes.text_en: Facsimile of this page in Sharpe, Journ. Brit. archl. assoc. 1897 p. 103, cf. p. 107.

transcription.doubts: The Latin quotation is left in Latin in the crib. 'Londoñ' has a tilde (abbreviation mark) over n; 'pręd' has an e-caudata (ę).
